[SWS_DM_00847] Reinitialization of Service Instance on Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation
⌈
On Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation,
the Diagnostic Server instance shall reset the values of the fields of the as-
sociated diag::Conversation class Instance according to [SWS_DM_00843].
⌋
